technique.murim.ceremonial_draw.weakness: Cannot be turned aside once begun.
technique.murim.shadow_step.weakness: Leaves the flank open on landing.
technique.murim.crescent_sweep.weakness: Wide arc leaves the guard low.
murim.technique.pressure: The enemy's aura presses down — your qi will not gather.
murim.technique.not_awakened: Your dantian is not formed yet.
technique.murim.demon_palm.weakness: Must be gathered at arm's length — no reach.
item.murim.method_scroll.hint: Use to learn the method. Then meditate to sense qi.
murim.method.unreadable: The writing has faded — it cannot be read.
murim.method.warn_same_nature: Switch methods? Same nature, but part of your stored qi will be lost. Use while sneaking to confirm.
murim.method.warn_other_nature: Switch methods? Different nature — all stored qi will disperse. Use while sneaking to confirm.
murim.method.learn.learned: You learned: %s. Sit and meditate to sense qi.
murim.method.learn.replaced_before_seed: You now practise: %s. Your practice starts over.
murim.method.learn.same_nature: You switched to %s. Part of your qi was lost.
murim.method.learn.other_nature: You switched to %s. Your former qi dispersed completely.
method.murim.six_harmonies.cost: Sect method. Slow but pure. Nature: pure.
method.murim.street_strength.cost: Fast but muddy: many impurities. Nature: pure.
method.murim.mountain_root.cost: Very slow, but a large reserve. Nature: pure.
method.murim.holy_fire_breath.cost: Cult method. Fast and strong, the demon's path. Nature: demonic.
method.murim.reverse_breathing.cost: Forbidden page. Night only, qi of the dead. Nature: dead.
murim.meditation.no_method: Nothing to practise: you need a cultivation method first.
murim.meditation.night_only: This method is practised only at night.
murim.meditation.begin.0: You sit down and seek the method's breath…
murim.meditation.begin.1: Warmth gathers into a ring. Hold it.
murim.meditation.begin.2: The ring is ready to contract. Squeeze it into a point.
murim.meditation.first_feeling: The warmth below the navel scattered: qi has nothing to rest on. Try again.
murim.meditation.held: The ring held. Now compress it into a seed.
murim.meditation.seed: A seed is born in your dantian.
murim.meditation.backlash: Your qi runs wild — qi deviation. Your body barely holds.
murim.mastery.learned: You learned “%s”. The form is familiar but clumsy — it has to be lived in.
murim.mastery.learned_skipped: You learned “%s” and already hold it at layer %s.
murim.mastery.deeper: The continuation of “%s” opens new layers.
murim.mastery.missing: The words make no sense: you lack the basics — “%s”, layer %s.
murim.mastery.comprehended: You grasped the essence of “%s”. Your understanding of martial arts deepened.
murim.loadout.title: Techniques
murim.loadout.empty: Slot is empty — set up techniques: [%s]
murim.rank.breakthrough.begin: Your qi has hit the wall. Stay still — breakthrough: %s
murim.rank.breakthrough.broken: Breakthrough interrupted: meridians damaged, some qi lost
murim.rank.wall.technique: Your qi has hit the wall. Master a technique to layer %s to break through
murim.rank.wall.max: Your qi has hit the wall. There is no path further yet
murim.rank.breakthrough.title: Breakthrough
technique.murim.six_harmonies.weakness: The straight overhead strike shows in the shoulders.
technique.murim.dark_fragrance_step.weak: After the dash you need a moment to settle into stance.
technique.murim.seven_plum_blossoms.weak: Half a second of stance: anyone who reads it can step off the line.
technique.murim.wind_god_steps.weakness: Any hit breaks the run; the Flicker step is short and needs a moment after.
technique.murim.seven_plum_blossoms.scho: Ultimate Seven Plum Blossoms Sword Technique
technique.murim.seven_plum_whirlwind.wea: A long cast: leave the ring of pillars before the walls close.
technique.murim.seven_plum_execution.wea: The clones strike where you stood: step off the gathering point before they arrive.
technique.murim.seven_plum_rush.weakness: A long stance and a straight line: step out of the hurricane's path.
technique.murim.seven_plum_basic.weaknes: Plain strikes of the style: no reach beyond the blade.
technique.murim.twenty_four_plum_rainfal: The rain falls from the sky: under a roof the petals cannot reach. Run far enough and the illusion breaks.
technique.murim.twenty_four_plum_dome.we: The Dome stands where it was planted, and only in front: it does not guard the back, the sky above or the space inside. Step out from behind the trunks and the lattice falls apart. While it holds, the sword is busy - no strikes.
technique.murim.falling_petal_sword.weak: The rush circles to your back from the left: in the pause after the pivot, step the other way.
technique.murim.dark_fragrance_trail.wea: A straight run reads from afar; press R again to stop.
technique.murim.dark_fragrance_behind.we: Without a target it is a plain step forward.
technique.murim.wind_god_shadow.weakness: Does not shake off a chase already started; striking or being hurt reveals you.
technique.murim.wind_god_death.weakness: A breach without damage: room for a strike, not the strike.
technique.murim.wind_god_lightning.weakn: Hard to turn at speed; a wall ends the run.
